reference.capture: Hades PTY replay with TIOCSWINSZ 120x40 and direct CSI-u byte writes

normalization: Each case runs in a fresh Hades process with a synthetic HERMES_HOME and HOME.
ANSI control sequences, cursor placement, colors, timestamps, prompt faces, and dynamic working-directory text are not asserted.
The PTY window is explicitly set to 120 columns by 40 rows before input is sent.
Modified Enter bytes are written directly to the PTY master; tmux key translation is not used.
Ready modified-Enter behavior is identified by both logical composer lines and the absence of the busy interrupt marker.
This contract covers only Shift and Alt modifier events decoded by crossterm; alternate terminal encodings remain outside the claim.
